internalWorkOrders.title: Internal Work Orders
internalWorkOrders.subtitle: Internal maintenance orders (Fuel Station only). Execute via your own team.

linkedProviders.title: Linked Service Providers
linkedProviders.subtitle: Manage service providers linked to your station. Linked providers are shown below; choose one to remove or add from available providers.
linkedProviders.linkedDescription: Providers already linked to your station. You can remove them below.
linkedProviders.noLinked: No linked providers. Add one from the "Available providers" section below.
linkedProviders.availableDescription: Choose a provider from the list and click Add to link them to your station.
linkedProviders.noAvailable: No available providers to add (all are already linked).

removeDialog.title: Remove linked provider
removeDialog.description: Are you sure you want to remove "{{name}}" from linked providers? You can add them again later from available providers.

create.title: New Maintenance Request
create.subtitle: Create internal (your team) or external (service provider) maintenance request.
create.modeHintInternal: Internal: the station executes the request with its own staff. The service provider cannot see internal requests.
create.modeHintExternal: External: the service provider executes it after a quote is selected and payment is confirmed (two-step).
create.providersDescription: Choose providers to send the request to now — it becomes QUOTING_OPEN. If you don't choose any provider, the request is created as SUBMITTED_BY_STATION and you can send it to providers later from the request detail page (Send to providers).
create.noLinkedProvidersPrefix: No linked providers. You can create the request now (it stays SUBMITTED_BY_STATION), then
create.noLinkedProvidersSuffix: and send the request from the request detail page later.
create.selectedProvidersCount: {{count}} provider(s) selected. The request will be sent to them and become QUOTING_OPEN.

toasts.createdPendingSend: Request created (SUBMITTED_BY_STATION). Send to providers from the request detail.

requestDetail.cancelledNote: Cancellation is final — no further transitions.
requestDetail.paymentRejectedNote: The job order remains awaiting payment and is not activated — it does not reach ACTIVE.
requestDetail.inactiveQuoteNote: A quote was rejected or withdrawn — the request may continue with another provider or quote. Rejected or withdrawn quotes cannot be selected.
requestDetail.paymentConfirmedTitle: Payment sent confirmed. Waiting for provider confirmation.
requestDetail.paymentConfirmedNote: Next step: the provider (owner of the selected quote) logs into their service-provider account, opens Provider Job Orders, opens the job order, then clicks "Confirm received" to activate it and start work. If the provider can't see it, make sure they're logged in with the provider organization account whose quote was accepted.
requestDetail.paymentHint: Confirm payment from here — the station confirms it sent the amount to the provider.
requestDetail.paymentSteps: 1) Upload the transfer receipt. 2) (Optional) reference number / amount / method. 3) Click "Confirm payment sent".

toasts.alreadyConfirmed: Payment already confirmed for this job order.
toasts.uploadOrRefRequired: Upload a receipt or enter a reference number before confirming.
toasts.paymentConfirmed: Payment sent confirmed. The provider will see the job order in the Provider Job Orders list (from their provider account) and click "Confirm received" to activate the order and start.
toasts.fileTooLarge: File size too large. Maximum size is 5MB.
toasts.receiptUploaded: Receipt uploaded. Click "Confirm payment sent" to confirm.

jobOrderDetail.paymentRejectedNote: The job order remains awaiting payment and is not activated — it does not reach ACTIVE.
jobOrderDetail.paymentConfirmedTitle: Payment sent confirmed. Waiting for provider confirmation.
jobOrderDetail.paymentConfirmedNote: The provider logs in, opens Provider Job Orders, opens this order (job order #{{id}}), then clicks "Confirm received". If the provider can't see the order in the list, they must be logged in with the provider organization account whose quote was accepted.
jobOrderDetail.paymentHint: Confirm payment from here — the station confirms it sent the amount to the provider.
jobOrderDetail.paymentSteps: 1) Upload the transfer receipt. 2) (Optional) enter reference number / amount / method. 3) Click "Confirm payment sent".

toasts.fileTooLarge: File size too large. Maximum size is 5MB.
toasts.alreadyConfirmed: Payment already confirmed for this job order.
toasts.receiptUploaded: Receipt uploaded. Click "Confirm payment sent" to confirm.
toasts.uploadOrRefRequired: Upload a receipt or enter a reference number before confirming.
toasts.paymentConfirmed: Payment sent confirmed. Waiting for provider to confirm receipt.
